notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Magda by tapping it, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat for infinite Treasure tokens.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you can use them to activate Magda's ability to put all artifacts and Dragons in your library onto the battlefield.
